item.text:
It provides order helpers: totals line items, applies percentage discount codes, computes an “average” price, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (`undefined`) and throws. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides an extended total (`price * qty`) by number of line items, so it is not an average item/unit price when quantities exceed 1. It should divide by total quantity if that is the intent.
- `averageItemPrice([])` would divide by zero (after fixing `calcTotal`), yielding `NaN`.
